The model stores each id as a natural number. The digest laws require each id to be less than 2^256. This bound applies to a record's id and each id that it references. The protocol supplies the bound through its 32-byte SHA-256 digests. A number is not a hash of the record's envelope, so nothing in the model keeps a record's prev from naming itself or a record above it. The keyed slice laws that need prev to have no cycle state it as a premise (NoCycle); a real id gives it, since it is a hash of an envelope that holds its prev. The model does not derive fold records from stored records. No theorem connects a fold record's times to the checks on a stored record's envelope.
The model projects a stored opening to all its written top-level fields. Every name, including value and n, is looked up in the same list.
Fold records carry time text and its parsed values (Stamp, Claim). Their other envelope fields are direct inputs, not fields parsed from an envelope.
Text is a list of lines; splitting a file into lines is outside the model.
